newsitem.title: USA: Recount shows Democrat winner in Mass. Congress race.
newsitem.headline: Recount shows Democrat winner in Mass. Congress race.

text.p: A recount of votes cast in the state's 6th congressional district showed a razor-thin victory by Democrat John Tierney Monday over Republican incumbant Peter Torkildsen, as the initial count suggested.
Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth Wiliam Galvin said in a statement Tierney won by 371 votes, 133,694 to 133,323 for the freshman Republican.
Galvin said he expects the results to be certified by Gov. William Weld and the Governor's Council on Wednesday.
Tierney's victory mans the entire congressional delegation from Massachusetts will be Democratic.
